author: GameSpot
description:
Minato is remarkably athletic and agile, which helped her take her dance skills to victory in a major international competition. Though winning was "nice", she's always cared more about how dance can bring people together.

Her new part-time gig is helping her scientist friend NiCO with odd jobs. One of those tasks involves equipping a special device that can capture and recreate moves from other participants in the DOA Tournament. The device's workings, and her true objective, remain unknown...
